title: container hardening: the four controls on the 15 services (plan 10 row 10G-1)
note: basis 'shown' for H10G1-01: the HL7 validator was run as uid 10001 against an unwritable and a writable copy of its package cache; nothing was brought up under Docker (no daemon).

findings.claim: the adapter and the orchestrator cannot run with a read-only root filesystem: the HL7 validator (services/adapter/validate/validator.py, -Duser.home=/opt/hl7/home) writes .index.json files into and renames packages in its package cache, an image path, and stops with 'Unable to rename directory ... for atomic delete' when it cannot; the fix is a writable package home in the validator, then the two read_only exceptions of D-1323 go

llm-service (vLLM) runs as root with a writable root filesystem (D-1323 exceptions): its compile and kernel caches are under /root/.cache and /tmp; a fixed user and read_only need the caches on a volume, proved on a GPU box

the overlay services outside the base file's 15 carry none or only some of the four controls: llm-verifier, judge-sleep-init, judge-wake-init, model-swap-init, caddy, authelia, prometheus, doctor (tests/unit/test_container_hardening.py OUTSIDE_THE_15)

a reference data pack that fails to load at install is only a stderr warning (deploy/install.sh, the deploy/refdata/pending loop's 'install: warning: reference data ... not loaded' line) and install goes on; under the 10G-1 read-only root the pack's 'compose cp' into criteria-compiler failed that way and only the box rehearsal's later check noticed (CI run 44458900188); the load is fixed (a one-off compose run with the pack bind-mounted), the quiet failure is open

update's rollback (tools/trialbox/update.py RESTORE_SH, mktemp in the db container) writes the dump's whole plain SQL script into db's tmpfs /tmp, which counts against db's memory limit (TB_MEM_DB, 4g by default); a database whose script outgrows it can stop db during a rollback; streaming it needs a way to fail the single transaction when pg_restore fails mid-stream
